hero.titlePost: it calls venues and chases sponsors so you don't have to.
hero.sub: Tarima is the back-office teammate for organizers of meetups, dinners and hackathons. Brief it once; it works email, phone and chat, and fills your board until every row is done.
hero.note: Free while in early access. We onboard a few organizers each week.
board.brief: 25-person founder dinner in Paris, mid-November, under €3,500
board.briefSponsors: 12 sponsors for the spring hackathon — logos, invoices, slides
jobs.sub: Every row is an outside party who owes you something. Your agent works the channels until each cell is filled.
jobs.tab1desc: It calls and emails venues, parses their quotes and menus, and lays out the comparison — you pick, it books.
jobs.tab2desc: It chases logos, invoices, slide decks and contracts across email and chat, and flags the ones that need you.
how.titlePre: Brief it. Watch the board fill.
how.s1d: Tell Tarima the event, the date, the city and the constraints — or drop in the sheet you already keep.
how.s2d: Emails, calls and messages go out under your name. Quotes, PDFs and replies come back parsed.
how.s3d: Every venue, sponsor and speaker becomes a row with live status. Your whole team sees the same truth.
how.s4d: Nothing is committed, booked or signed without your say-so. Escalations land where you already chat.
why.titlePre: Built for the work, not the
why.c1d: No event specialist who calls you back next week. The agent starts tonight and reports as it goes.
why.c2d: No demo call, no procurement. Request access, drop a brief, watch it work.
why.c3d: Chat is for updates and approvals. The real product is the board — structured state your whole team shares.
proof.title: It actually makes the calls.
proof.t1: "Hi, I'm calling on behalf of a founder dinner on November 14th — do you have a private room for 25 that evening?"
proof.t2: "…great — and is there a minimum spend for a Tuesday buyout?"
proof.t3: "Perfect. Could you send the group menu PDF to this address? Thank you."
proof.note: Recorded with the venue's knowledge. Full clips inside the app.
pricing.title: Free while we onboard early organizers.
pricing.sub: Paid plans for teams and agencies when we open up. Community and OSS events stay free.
pricing.card1d: Early-access organizers run events free while we onboard in batches.
pricing.card2d: Unlimited events, shared boards, client views and priority calling windows.
pricing.card3d: OSS meetups, NGOs and community events keep a free tier — your events still help the venue graph.
faq.a1: Yes. When email goes unanswered near your date, Tarima calls during local business hours, asks your questions, and writes the answers to your board.
faq.q2: Can it book or sign anything without me?
faq.a2: Never. It inquires, collects and prepares — every commitment waits for your explicit approval.
faq.q3: Does my team need new accounts?
faq.a3: Co-organizers join your board from a link. Updates and approvals land in the chat you already use.
faq.q4: What about my existing Luma page?
faq.a4: Keep it. Tarima is the back office — Luma stays the invite, we run everything behind it.
